book_name: 雅思口语写作通用观点库

chapters.name: list1  教育类 （ 个人发展）

words.tr: phrase. 培养创造力；促进创造性思维
words.ex: The teacher uses games to foster creativity in students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用游戏来培养学生的创造力。
words.en: To promote and encourage the development of creative thinking and original ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 批判性思维
words.ex: He uses critical thinking to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用批判性思维解决问题。
words.en: Critical thinking is the objective analysis and evaluation of an issue in order to form a judgment.

words.tr: n. 解决问题
words.ex: He is good at problem-solving tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决问题的任务。
words.en: The process of finding solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.tr: phrase. 终身学习；持续一生的学习过程
words.ex: He believes in lifelong learning.
words.ex_cn: 他相信终身学习。
words.en: Lifelong learning refers to the ongoing, voluntary, and self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for either personal or professional reasons. It enhances social inclusion, active citizenship, and personal development, but also self-sustainability, as well as competitiveness and employability.

words.tr: phrase. 协作学习；一种通过小组合作、共同参与来促进学习的方法
words.ex: Collaborative learning encourages students to work together and share their knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 协作学习鼓励学生一起工作并分享他们的知识。
words.en: A method of learning in which students work together in small groups to solve a problem, complete a task, or create a product.

words.tr: phrase. 学习效率；学习效能
words.ex: He improved his learning efficiency by using flashcards.
words.ex_cn: 他通过使用闪卡提高了学习效率。
words.en: Learning efficiency refers to the ability to learn effectively and in a time-saving manner, maximizing the output from the input of study time and effort.

words.tr: phrase. 平等的教育；指每个人无论背景如何都享有接受相同质量教育的权利和机会
words.ex: Every child deserves equal education opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应享有平等的教育机会。
words.en: Equal education refers to the principle that all individuals should have the same opportunities to access education, regardless of their background, gender, or socio-economic status.

words.tr: phrase. 教育标准；指教育体系中规定的教学质量和学习成果的衡量准则
words.ex: The school raised its educational standards last year.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校去年提高了它的教育标准。
words.en: Established benchmarks or criteria used to measure the quality and effectiveness of education.

words.tr: phrase. 技术整合；指将技术融入教学、工作流程或系统中以提升效率或功能
words.ex: The school uses technology integration to help students learn better.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过技术整合帮助学生更好地学习。
words.en: The strategic combination of different technologies to work together seamlessly, enhancing overall functionality and user experience.

words.tr: phrase. 教师培训；师资培训
words.ex: She is joining teacher training this summer.
words.ex_cn: 她今年夏天要参加教师培训。
words.en: Teacher training refers to the process of equipping individuals with the skills and knowledge necessary to teach effectively in educational settings.

words.tr: phrase. 学生参与；指学生在学习过程中的积极参与和投入程度
words.ex: The teacher used interactive activities to increase student engagement.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用互动活动来提高学生的参与度。
words.en: Student engagement refers to the degree of attention, curiosity, interest, optimism, and passion that students show when they are learning or being taught, which extends to the level of motivation they have to learn and progress in their education.

words.tr: phrase. 理论与实践之间的桥梁
words.ex: This internship helps build a theory-practice bridge for students.
words.ex_cn: 这份实习帮助学生搭建理论与实践之间的桥梁。

chapters.name: list2 教育优缺点（ 个人发展）

words.tr: phrase. 批判性思维和解决问题的能力
words.uk: ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ænd ˈprɒbləm ˈsɒlvɪŋ skɪls
words.us: ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ænd ˈprɑːbləm ˈsɑːlvɪŋ skɪlz
words.ex: Students need critical thinking and problem-solving skills to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要批判性思维和解决问题的能力来通过考试。
words.en: The ability to analyze information objectively and develop effective solutions to complex issues.

words.tr: phrase. 培养全面技能；培育综合技能
words.ex: Teachers should nurture comprehensive skills in young students.
words.ex_cn: 教师应该培养年轻学生的综合能力。
words.en: To develop a wide range of abilities and competencies in an individual.

words.tr: phrase. 为社会培养人才
words.ex: Schools should cultivate talents for society.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该为社会培养人才。
words.en: To educate and develop individuals to become valuable contributors to the community.

words.tr: phrase. 满足行业需求；符合产业要求
words.ex: The school is changing its courses to meet industry demands.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在改变课程以满足行业需求。
words.en: Satisfying the specific needs and requirements of various professions or sectors.

words.tr: phrase. 提高道德标准；提升道德水准
words.ex: The school tries to improve moral standard by teaching kindness.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过教授善良来提高道德标准。
words.en: To enhance the level of ethical principles and behavior in a community.

words.tr: phrase. 提升职业前景；改善就业发展机会
words.ex: He studies hard to improve career prospects.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以改善职业前景。
words.en: To make one's chances of finding and advancing in a job more favourable or successful.

words.tr: phrase. 给家庭施加经济压力；让家庭承担经济负担
words.ex: He is putting financial pressure on his family by spending too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他因为花太多钱而给家人带来了经济压力。
words.en: Imposing a financial strain on one's family unit.

words.tr: phrase. 无法相应地进行教学；不能根据情况施教
words.ex: He doesn't understand the students, so he can't teach accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他不了解学生，因此无法因材施教。
words.en: To be unable to instruct or guide students in an appropriate or effective manner.

words.tr: 限制个人思想
words.ex: He tries to limit personal thought in his report.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在报告中限制个人想法。
words.en: To restrict or confine an individual's capacity for independent thought and creativity.

words.tr: phrase. 文化适应困难
words.ex: Many students face cultural adjustment difficulties when they study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在出国留学时会遇到文化适应困难。

words.w: unhealthy in terms of social development
words.tr: phrase. 在社会发展方面不健康的；指在社会关系、社会适应或社会成长方面存在不良或有害状态
words.uk: ˌʌnˈhelθi ɪn təz ɒv ˈsəʊʃəl dɪˈveləpmənt
words.us: ˌʌnˈhelθi ɪn tərz əv ˈsoʊʃəl dəˈveləpmənt
words.ex: The child's behavior is unhealthy in terms of social development.
words.ex_cn: 从社会发展来看，这个孩子的行为是不健康的。
words.en: Detrimental to the development of social skills and community well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏社会实践；缺少社会经验
words.ex: He has a lack of social practice, so he feels nervous in groups.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏社会实践，所以在人群中感到紧张。
words.en: Absence of opportunities to engage in social activities and interactions.

words.tr: phrase. 加强数字素养教育
words.ex: The school plans to strengthen digital literacy education for all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校计划加强所有学生的数字素养教育。

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励合乎道德的技术设计
words.ex: Schools should encourage ethical tech design to protect users' privacy.
words.ex_cn: 学校应鼓励合乎道德的技术设计以保护用户的隐私。

words.tr: phrase. 促进绿色技术创新
words.ex: The government funds projects to foster green tech innovation.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助项目以促进绿色技术创新。

words.tr: phrase. 提升公共服务的电子化水平
words.ex: The government plans to enhance public e-services by making more forms available online.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划通过提供更多在线表格来提升公共服务的电子化水平。

words.tr: phrase. 推广远程工作灵活性
words.ex: The company wants to promote remote work flexibility to help employees balance life and work.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司希望推广远程工作灵活性，以帮助员工平衡生活与工作。

words.tr: phrase. 升级城市智能基础设施
words.ex: The city plans to upgrade urban smart infrastructure to reduce traffic jams.
words.ex_cn: 该市计划升级城市智能基础设施以减少交通拥堵。

words.tr: phrase. 确保残疾人获得技术无障碍访问
words.ex: The school must ensure tech accessibility for disabled students.
words.ex_cn: 学校必须确保残疾人学生能够无障碍使用技术。

words.tr: phrase. 保护数据隐私
words.ex: Companies must safeguard data privacy to protect their customers.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须保护数据隐私以保护客户。

words.tr: phrase. 在网上打击虚假信息
words.ex: The government works to combat misinformation online by removing fake news.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过删除假新闻来在网上打击虚假信息。

words.tr: phrase. 阻止网络欺凌
words.ex: Schools should teach students to deter cyber-bullying.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该教导学生阻止网络欺凌。

chapters.name: list4 科技与社会优缺点

words.tr: phrase. 提高效率；提高效益
words.ex: The new tool enhances efficiency at work.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具提高了工作效率。
words.en: To improve productivity or effectiveness.

words.tr: phrase. 提供便利；带来方便
words.ex: The app offers convenience to users.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序为用户带来便利。
words.en: To provide ease and efficiency in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 以多种方式获取信息；通过各种途径取得资料
words.ex: He obtains information in various ways by reading books and asking friends.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书和问朋友以多种方式获取信息。
words.en: To gather facts or data through multiple methods such as reading, observation, or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 促进跨区域交流
words.ex: The program aims to promote cross-regional exchanges among students.
words.ex_cn: 该项目旨在促进学生之间的跨区域交流。
words.en: To encourage interaction and communication between different regions.

words.tr: phrase. 促进社会发展；推动社会进步
words.ex: The new policy aims to promote social development.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策旨在促进社会发展。
words.en: To encourage or support the progress and improvement of society.

words.w: resulting in high dependence on technology
words.tr: phrase. 导致对技术的高度依赖
words.ex: Using phones all day is resulting in high dependence on technology.
words.ex_cn: 整天使用手机导致对技术的高度依赖。

words.tr: phrase. 社交互动减少
words.ex: Social interaction decreases when people stay home all day.
words.ex_cn: 当人们整天待在家里时，社交互动会减少。
words.en: A reduction in face-to-face communication and social bonding.

words.tr: phrase. 对青少年的负面影响；对青少年产生的不良作用
words.ex: Social media has negative effects on teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体对青少年有负面影响。
words.en: Harmful impacts on young people, especially in their development.

words.tr: phrase. 导致失业；造成失业
words.ex: The factory closed and resulted in unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭导致了失业。
words.en: To cause joblessness or a lack of employment opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 侵犯隐私；隐私权被侵害
words.ex: The paparazzi's constant invasion of privacy has led to numerous lawsuits.
words.ex_cn: 狗仔队不断的隐私侵犯导致了众多诉讼。
words.en: The act of intruding into someone's personal matters without their consent, often leading to discomfort or distress.

words.tr: phrase. 网络欺诈；网络诈骗
words.ex: He lost money to cyber fraud last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月因网络诈骗损失了钱。
words.en: Illegal activities conducted over the internet to deceive or steal.

chapters.name: list5 文化与社会价值观类

words.tr: phrase. 尊重传统习俗
words.ex: We should respect traditional customs during the Spring Festival.
words.ex_cn: 我们在春节期间应该尊重传统习俗。

words.tr: phrase. 庆祝民族认同
words.ex: People celebrate national identity with parades and traditional songs.
words.ex_cn: 人们通过游行和传统歌曲来庆祝民族认同。

words.tr: phrase. 促进跨文化交流
words.ex: Schools should foster intercultural dialogue by inviting students from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 学校应通过邀请来自不同国家的学生来促进跨文化交流。

words.tr: phrase. 抵制文化挪用
words.ex: She speaks out to combat cultural appropriation in fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她发声抵制时尚中的文化挪用。

words.tr: phrase. 保护文化遗产；保存文化遗产
words.ex: Governments should take actions to preserve cultural heritage for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 政府应采取行动保护文化遗产，为子孙后代保留。
words.en: To protect and maintain the cultural heritage for future generations, ensuring that historical sites, traditions, and artifacts are kept intact and respected.

words.tr: phrase. 促进文化多样性；倡导多元文化
words.ex: The school helps to promote cultural diversity.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助促进文化多样性。
words.en: To encourage and support the variety of cultures within a society.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励艺术表达
words.ex: The school encourages artistic expression through painting and music classes.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过绘画和音乐课鼓励艺术表达。

words.tr: phrase. 缩小代际差距
words.ex: Grandparents and grandchildren play games together to bridge generation gaps.
words.ex_cn: 祖父母和孙辈一起玩游戏来缩小代际差距。

words.tr: phrase. 加强社区凝聚力；增强社区成员之间的团结与联系
words.ex: Volunteers help to strengthen community cohesion by organizing local events.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者通过组织本地活动来增强社区凝聚力。
words.en: To make the bonds within a community stronger, enhancing unity and cooperation among its members.

words.tr: phrase. 支持少数民族语言
words.ex: The government helps to support minority languages by funding schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过资助学校来支持少数民族语言。

words.tr: phrase. 培养社会责任感
words.ex: Schools should cultivate social responsibility in students.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该在学生中培养社会责任感。
words.en: To develop a sense of duty and concern for the welfare of the community and society.

chapters.name: list6 文化与社会优缺点

words.tr: phrase. 培养民族自豪感和认同感
words.ex: Schools aim to instill national pride and identity through history lessons.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过历史课培养民族自豪感和认同感。

words.w: satisfy people's spiritual and emotional needs
words.tr: phrase. 满足人们的精神与情感需求
words.uk: ˈsætɪsfaɪ ˈpiːplz ˈspɪrɪtʃuəl ænd ɪˈməʊʃənəl niːdz
words.us: ˈsætɪsfaɪ ˈpiːplz ˈspɪrɪtʃuəl ænd ɪˈmoʊʃənəl nidz
words.ex: Music helps satisfy people's spiritual and emotional needs.
words.ex_cn: 音乐有助于满足人们的精神和情感需求。
words.en: Meet the deeper psychological and emotional requirements of individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 激发创造力和创新
words.ex: The teacher used fun games to ignite creativity and innovation in students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用有趣的游戏激发学生的创造力和创新。

words.tr: 短语动词. 打破刻板印象和误解
words.ex: She works to break stereotypes and misconceptions about women in science.
words.ex_cn: 她努力打破关于女性在科学领域的刻板印象和误解。
words.en: Challenge and dismantle oversimplified or incorrect beliefs about a group or culture.

words.tr: phrase. 增强文化出口
words.ex: The government wants to enhance cultural export by supporting traditional art films.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过支持传统艺术电影来增强文化出口。

words.tr: phrase. 使价值观与信仰长久延续；使价值观和信念代代相传
words.ex: Parents perpetuate values and beliefs through daily stories.
words.ex_cn: 父母通过日常故事传承价值观和信仰。
words.en: Continue and reinforce the transmission of core principles and ideas over time.

words.w: a devastating blow to traditional values
words.tr: phrase. 对传统价值观的沉重打击；对传统价值观念的毁灭性冲击
words.uk: ə dɪˈvæstətɪŋ bləʊ tuː trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈvæljuːz
words.us: ə dɪˈvæstəteɪtɪŋ bloʊ tuː trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈvæljuz
words.ex: The new law was a devastating blow to traditional values.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对传统价值观造成了毁灭性的打击。
words.en: A severe and damaging impact on long-established cultural principles.

words.tr: phrase. 削弱地方特色；使本地独特性减弱
words.ex: Global brands can weaken local distinctiveness.
words.ex_cn: 全球品牌可能会削弱地方特色。
words.en: Diminish the unique qualities that make a local culture distinct.

words.tr: phrase. 导致文化同质化
words.ex: Globalization can result in cultural homogenization.
words.ex_cn: 全球化可能导致文化同质化。

words.tr: phrase. 加剧歧视和偏见；助长对某群体的不公平对待和成见
words.ex: False news can fuel discrimination and prejudice.
words.ex_cn: 虚假新闻会加剧歧视和偏见。
words.en: Encourage unfair treatment and negative preconceptions against others.

words.tr: v. 阻碍全球合作
words.ex: Trade wars can hinder global cooperation.
words.ex_cn: 贸易战会阻碍全球合作。

chapters.name: list7 健康与生活方式类（快乐幸福）

words.tr: phrase. 促进身体活动
words.ex: Schools should promote physical activity to keep students healthy.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该促进身体活动以保持学生健康。

words.tr: phrase. 抵制久坐不动的生活方式
words.ex: Exercise regularly to combat sedentary lifestyles.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼以抵制久坐不动的生活方式。

words.tr: v. 鼓励均衡饮食
words.ex: Parents should encourage balanced diets for their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该鼓励孩子吃均衡的饮食。
words.en: To promote or support the consumption of a variety of foods in appropriate amounts.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止过度饮酒
words.ex: Higher taxes on alcohol can deter excessive alcohol consumption.
words.ex_cn: 提高酒精税可以阻止过度饮酒。

words.tr: phrase. 心理健康意识
words.ex: Schools are promoting mental health awareness to help students feel supported.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在推广心理健康意识，以帮助学生感到被支持。

words.tr: phrase. 促进工作与生活平衡
words.ex: Companies should foster work-life balance by offering flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司应通过提供灵活的工作时间来促进工作与生活平衡。

words.tr: phrase. 使寻求心理治疗变得正常化 无中文释义
words.ex: Talking openly about mental health helps normalize seeking therapy.
words.ex_cn: 公开谈论心理健康有助于使寻求心理治疗变得正常化。

words.tr: phrase. 规范垃圾食品广告
words.ex: The government wants to regulate junk-food advertising to protect children.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望规范垃圾食品广告，以保护儿童。

words.tr: 短语动词. 在公共场所禁止吸烟
words.ex: Many cities ban smoking in public places to protect people's health.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市禁止在公共场所吸烟，以保护人们的健康。
words.en: To prohibit the act of smoking in areas accessible to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 支持公共医疗资金
words.ex: Many people support public healthcare funding to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 许多人支持公共医疗资金以帮助穷人。

words.tr: phrase. 扩展健康筛查项目
words.ex: The government plans to extend health-screening programmes to rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划将健康筛查项目扩展到农村地区。

chapters.name: list8 环境与可持续发展类

words.tr: phrase. 应对气候变化；与气候变暖作斗争
words.ex: We must combat climate change by reducing our carbon footprint.
words.ex_cn: v. 我们必须通过减少碳足迹来对抗气候变化。
words.en: To combat climate change means to take action to reduce or prevent the effects of climate change, such as global warming, by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and implementing sustainable practices.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励循环经济
words.ex: The government encourages circular economy by recycling waste.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过回收废物来鼓励循环经济。

words.tr: phrase. 推动可再生能源转型
words.ex: The government wants to promote renewable energy transition by funding solar panels.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过资助太阳能电池板来推动可再生能源转型。

words.tr: phrase. 减少一次性塑料制品的使用
words.ex: We should reduce single-use plastics to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该减少一次性塑料制品的使用来保护环境。

words.tr: phrase. 减少碳足迹
words.ex: We can cut carbon footprints by using buses instead of cars.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以乘坐公交车而不是开车来减少碳足迹。

words.tr: phrase. 发展绿色城市交通
words.ex: The city plans to develop green urban transport by adding bike lanes and electric buses.
words.ex_cn: 该市计划通过增加自行车道和电动公交车来发展绿色城市交通。

words.tr: phrase. 保护生物多样性热点地区
words.ex: We must protect biodiversity hotspots to save rare animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须保护生物多样性热点地区，以拯救稀有动植物。

words.tr: v. 保护淡水资源；节约使用淡水，防止浪费和污染
words.ex: We must conserve freshwater resources for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护淡水资源。
words.en: To protect and use freshwater sources carefully to ensure long-term availability.

words.tr: phrase. 支持植树造林项目
words.ex: We should support reforestation projects to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该支持植树造林项目以保护环境。

words.tr: phrase. 实施更严格的排放标准
words.ex: The government will enforce stricter emission standards to reduce air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府将实施更严格的排放标准以减少空气污染。

words.tr: phrase. 提高年轻人的环保意识
words.ex: Schools should raise eco-awareness among youth by teaching recycling.
words.ex_cn: 学校应通过教授回收利用来提高年轻人的环保意识。

chapters.name: list9 职场与经济发展类

words.tr: phrase. 提升劳动力技能
words.ex: The company trains workers to enhance workforce skills.
words.ex_cn: 公司培训员工以提升劳动力技能。

words.tr: phrase. 提高就业率
words.ex: The new policy aims to boost employment rates in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策旨在提高农村地区的就业率。

words.tr: phrase. 减少收入不平等；缩小收入差距
words.ex: The government wants to reduce income inequality by raising the minimum wage.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过提高最低工资来减少收入不平等。
words.en: Lessen the gap between the rich and the poor.

words.tr: phrase. 促进公平工资
words.ex: The company works to promote fair wages for all employees.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司努力为所有员工促进公平工资。

words.tr: phrase. 打击职场歧视
words.ex: The company launched a program to combat workplace discrimination.
words.ex_cn: 该公司发起了一项打击职场歧视的计划。

words.tr: phrase. 确保职业安全
words.ex: The company must ensure occupational safety for all workers.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须确保所有工人的职业安全。

words.tr: phrase. 升级数字基础设施
words.ex: The city plans to upgrade digital infrastructure to improve internet speed.
words.ex_cn: 该城市计划升级数字基础设施以提高网速。

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励创业
words.ex: The government offers tax breaks to encourage entrepreneurship.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供税收减免以鼓励创业。

words.tr: phrase. 支持中小企业
words.ex: The government gives money to support small and medium enterprises.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供资金来支持中小企业。

words.tr: phrase. 吸引外国直接投资
words.ex: The government lowered taxes to attract foreign direct investment.
words.ex_cn: 政府降低了税收以吸引外国直接投资。

words.tr: phrase. 成长机会；发展机遇；增长潜力
words.ex: He found new opportunities for growth at his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中找到了新的成长机会。
words.en: Chances for personal or professional development and advancement.

words.tr: phrase. 提高收入水平；提升所得水平
words.ex: He works hard to raise income level for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以提高家人的收入水平。
words.en: Increase the amount of money earned, typically through employment or investment.

words.tr: phrase. 培养技术能力；发展专业技术熟练度
words.ex: He is developing technical proficiencies in coding and data analysis.
words.ex_cn: 他正在培养编程和数据分析方面的技术能力。
words.en: Build or improve skills and knowledge in specific technical or professional areas.

words.tr: phrase. 平衡工作与生活
words.ex: He tries to balance work and life by going home early.
words.ex_cn: 他通过早点回家来平衡工作和生活。
words.en: To balance work and life means to manage one's time and energy between work and personal life effectively to achieve satisfaction in both areas.

words.w: gain sense of identity and achievement
words.tr: phrase. 获得身份认同感和成就感
words.uk: ɡeɪn sɛns ʌv aɪˈdentəti ænd əˌtʃiːvmənt
words.us: ɡeɪn sɛns ʌv aɪˈdɛntəti ænd əˌtʃiːvmənt
words.ex: He gains a sense of identity and achievement through his art.
words.ex_cn: 他通过艺术获得身份感和成就感。
words.en: Acquire a feeling of self-worth and accomplishment through one's actions or achievements.

words.tr: phrase. 高失业率
words.ex: The city has a high unemployment rate.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有很高的失业率。
words.en: A high percentage of the workforce without jobs, indicating economic difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 引起压力和焦虑
words.ex: Too much homework can cause stress and anxiety in students.
words.ex_cn: 过多的家庭作业会导致学生压力和焦虑。
words.en: To induce feelings of stress and anxiety in someone.

words.tr: phrase. 引起失眠；导致睡眠障碍
words.ex: Coffee can cause insomnia if you drink it late.
words.ex_cn: 如果你晚上喝咖啡，可能会导致失眠。
words.en: Lead to difficulty in falling or staying asleep.

words.tr: phrase. 挤出个人时间；压缩私人时间
words.ex: He often squeezes personal time to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他经常挤出私人时间来完成作业。
words.en: Reduce or limit the amount of time available for personal activities and relaxation.

words.tr: phrase. 引起健康问题
words.ex: Smoking can cause health issues.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟可能导致健康问题。
words.en: Result in physical or mental health problems.
